project: DĀR AL TAWḤĪD – globale Ḥadīṯ- und Āṯār-Synchronisierung
source: Ibn Abī Šaybah, al-Muṣannaf, Kitāb al-Adab, vol. 6
editorial: Original excerpts and transmission paths checked against Arabic work pages.
Separate scholarly attribution and meaningful paraphrase; no invented Sharh.
These are early Athar, not automatically authentic marfu Prophetic statements.
Individual chain grading is not complete: unresolved narrators/gaps explicitly disclosed.
Targeted duplicates search in the canonical GitHub corpus, not a full semantic similarity scan.
Avoid asserting separate print pagination where only digital page is available.
deployment: Full canonical catalog is shared by all public production surfaces (Web, iOS, Android, tvOS).
All live public surfaces must use same count and ascending canonical sequence; metadata and TV shell validator added.
Test App uses a representative capped sample (default 120), not the entire canonical library.
Internal HAD record keys never appear as visible card/reader/source/share numbering.
tvOS screensaver keeps its pre-existing shuffle-rotation but uses full canonical inventory.
